olivia: Proposing we formalize an 'epoch' for inbound sessions — small window where a session can be resumed on fallback without losing stream state.
samuel: curious, how big is the window? milliseconds or seconds?
olivia: thinking 250ms-2s default, tunable per route. tradeoff: too long => more memory for ephemeral state; too short => frequent fallback playbacks.
anya: can we use session IDs + seq numbers + a tombstone token for ordering? that helps de-dup on reconnec...
samuel: +1 for seq nums. what about cases where connection upgrades or intermediate proxies drop trailers?
infra-bot: Deploy note: rolling out handshake-metadata header will need header whitelisting in frontdoor (PR queued).
olivia: rough sketch of semantics:

```
client: start -> session_id=S, seq=0
edge: accept, allocate ephemeral slot
if client disconnects within epoch:
  client reconnects with S, seq=n -> resume from KV cache
else
  session expires -> fallback to backup path (stateless replay)
```

samuel: if KV cache misses, do we fallback to replay from origin or call backup model variant?
olivia: fallback hierarchy: 1) resume from local KV; 2) fetch checkpoint from shared store (slow); 3) route to backup model variant (stateless, possibly lower perf); 4) fail.
kai: how do retries interact with hedging/charged tokens? we need to avoid double-billing clients for resumed tokens.
anya: propose attach a retry-metadata token so backends can mark resumed ranges as 'replayed' and not bill twice. also add idempotency-key at request level.
samuel: sounds good, but we need to ensure ad-hoc clients (curl) interop — fallback headers should be optional and harmless.
olivia: open questions: leaky memory from long epochs, QoS when many sessions in epoch, and metrics to detect resume effectiveness.
ania: typo — my name is anya :)
anya: haha noted.
infra-bot: Bob deployed gateway whitelist change to staging at 2140000020.
samuel: can someone draft an RFC with the state machine and storage costs? I'll pair on perf sim.
olivia: I'll assemble a short RFC and include perf knobs + default epoch=500ms. expect draft by EOD.
kai: add a note for accounting: resumed tokens flagged with X-RW-Resumed so billing pipeline can subtract duplicates.
olivia: thanks all :thumbsup:
